correctness.rationale: All cyclic-ring and first-entry quantifiers are explicit. Equal bonds are permanent; every finite disagreement-bond gap shrinks at both ends until length <=1, yielding exact time floor(maxgap/2). Parity of number of different bonds controls existence and gives exactly two vertex lifts. The transfer trace counts each permitted bond word twice via parity-coordinate closure, and the two all-different exceptions are added separately. Sharp extremal count 2n follows from minimum equal bonds of each parity. Standard independent-block and union-bound estimates prove typical T/log2(n)->1/2. The actual packaged simulation checks 524280 states n=3..18 against independently computed gap times and transfer traces; finite checks are corroboration, not the infinity proof.

value.rationale: A natural classical nonlinear one-dimensional CA has a full finite-size distribution of settling times, not only an endpoint structure. The exact formula computes any temporal layer with a finite transfer matrix; the extremal class has only 2n configurations even though the worst transient is linear, while typical settling is logarithmic. The contrast between labelled worst and uniform-random initial states, plus the parity-induced exceptional 2-cycle, addresses meaningful dynamical quantities. This is not a numerical table or arbitrary slice.
